Subject: Request: retention override + presign credential reconciliation for Whistic

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from the TorchBank security intake team — our regulator requires we retain the vendor SOC2 report and signed provenance for 5 years for critical data processors.

We reviewed your Whistic profile and the platform TTL is set to 12 months by default. Would Redwood consider a retention exception (RetentionOverride) for the SOC2 artifact and the presign manifest (proof-of-possession) to allow 60 months?

What we'd need from you:
- A copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II (redacted where appropriate) attached to the profile or a secure link (prefer Whistic attachment + secure link).
- A KMS-signed manifest of the upload (SHA256 + key id) we can use to validate possession; example format attached.
- Confirmation of who at Redwood will be the Whistic steward (email) so we can set policy and the retention flag.

If Whistic cannot set a retention longer than 12 months in the platform, would Redwood be willing to provide an external archival link (signed URL) that TorchBank can reference for the 5-year retention policy?

I've attached an example presign manifest and included the relevant Whistic profile link below. Happy to jump on a 20-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Senior Security Engineer, TorchBank

Karthik / Marcus / Alice —

I reviewed the ask. Security will approve a 60-month retention exception for the two artifacts (SOC2 PDF and presign manifest) with these conditions:

1) Manifest contains: original filename, SHA256 digest, KMS key id (key alias OK), timestamp, and uploader service principal.
2) KMS key used to sign manifests must be rotated per our policy (rotate keys every 24 months). Provide rotation schedule or exception plan if rotation window differs.
3) Access to the archived artifact must route to a signed URL with limited lifetime; the manifest remains the canonical proof of possession.
4) The Whistic RetentionOverride must be enabled only for the TorchBank profile and documented in our evidence inventory.

Marcus: can you confirm the following by EOD Monday?
- Whether Whistic supports a per-profile RetentionOverride and the admin steps to set it (screenshot or admin API call).
- The KMS alias we'll use to sign (or the service principal if we produce the signature outside KMS).
- If Whistic cannot hold >12 months, confirm the external archival S3 bucket and presign flow so I can sign off on the link pattern and TTL.

Alice: we'll upload the redacted SOC2 and the manifest to the Whistic profile first (flagged private), then follow up with the archival link if needed.

Approving conditionally — please treat this as timeboxed exception approval; any deviation requires rerun of our intake.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
